#### PostGIS & Spatial Database Workshop
**Location:** Tembalang, Semarang, Indonesia

Learn how to manage and analyze geospatial data using PostGIS and PostgreSQL. Covers installation, spatial queries, indexing, and integration with QGIS.
:::

**Location:** Online / Multiple Locations

Collaborative mapping event to improve OpenStreetMap coverage in Indonesian regions. All skill levels welcome — we provide training!

#### FOSS4G Hiroshima 2026
**Location:** Hiroshima, Japan
**Date:** 30 August – 3 September 2026

The global open source geospatial conference comes to Hiroshima, Japan. Join the international geospatial community for talks, workshops, and networking. OSGeo Indonesia delegation welcome!

## Past Events

### 2025

- **FOSS4G 2025** — Auckland, New Zealand (OSGeo Indonesia delegation)
- **QGIS Workshop Series** — Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya
- **OSGeo Indonesia Annual Meetup** — Yogyakarta
- **Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Mapathon** — Online, nationwide participation

### 2024

- **FOSS4G Asia 2024** — Community participation
- **GeoNode Training Workshop** — Jakarta
- **Open Data Day Indonesia** — Multiple cities
- **University GIS Day Celebrations** — Partner universities across Indonesia

### 2019

- **[Meet up Perdana OSGeo ID](https://twitter.com/osgeoid/status/1180163569993650176)** — 4 October 2019, the chapter's first community meetup

## Host an Event

Interested in hosting an OSGeo Indonesia event in your city or institution? We provide:

- Workshop materials and curricula
- Speaker and trainer connections
- Promotion through our community channels
- OSGeo branding and support

[Contact us](contact.qmd) to discuss hosting an event.

:::
